rationale: Stage 1 is posedge clk_b and stage 2 negedge clk_b inside the required depth: CDC-026 ERROR (stage edge mismatch, Async). CDC-043(a) will also report the opposite-edge s1_q->s2_q and s2_q->out_q paths, but its predicate fires identically on a benign intra-domain negedge pipeline, so it does not establish the seeded synchronizer defect and is not an expected rule (Reader A's CDC-043 addition rejected).

author_reading.rationale: Synchronizer stage 1 samples on posedge clk_b and stage 2 on negedge clk_b: stage clock-edge mismatch.

labels.rationale: The asynchronous crossing lands on a rising clk_b edge, then feeds a falling-edge stage. That stage feeds a rising-edge output register. The opposite-edge second stage breaks required chain matching.

In the 2-stage synchronizer from src_q (clk_a) into clk_b, stage 1 s1_q samples on posedge clk_b (design.sv:14) whereas stage 2 s2_q samples on negedge clk_b (design.sv:15), creating a required-stage clock-edge mismatch that cuts metastability settling time to a half cycle (CDC-026 ERROR Established).

settlement.rationale: Stage 1 is posedge clk_b and stage 2 negedge clk_b inside the required depth: CDC-026 ERROR (stage edge mismatch, Async). CDC-043(a) will also report the opposite-edge s1_q->s2_q and s2_q->out_q paths, but its predicate fires identically on a benign intra-domain negedge pipeline, so it does not establish the seeded synchronizer defect and is not an expected rule (Reader A's CDC-043 addition rejected).
